# Splunk

Primary sources:
- https://help.splunk.com/
- https://github.com/splunk/splunk-agent-skills
- https://github.com/splunk/security_content
- https://github.com/splunk/splunk-connect-for-syslog
- https://research.splunk.com/

Use for:
- Splunk Cloud/Enterprise/ES;
- SPL;
- CIM/data models;
- search performance;
- SAML/identity;
- ingestion/forwarders/HEC/syslog;
- indexes/retention/SmartStore;
- apps/add-ons;
- findings/notables/risk;
- upgrade/security readiness.

Treat official Agent Skills as workflow references, not as proof of environment state.
